folds.heading: ## Current authority and owner reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B86)
folds.body: All MP/DV/SZ/CH rows and reference/evidence boundaries were read, preserving the useful distinctions rather than turning a map into required spatial simulation or a chart into a new world sensor. Current desktop/laptop direction supersedes 1366-primary examples, and AD42 makes human review optional; actual new visible behavior retains AD36/AD43 proof. Root’s old “U7 added/running” paragraph is followed by the completed proposal/report snapshot, not proof these renderers or chart consumers shipped. Reference source dates/editions, indexed versus full text, source versus native inspection and failed-fetch limits remain historical; none was refreshed here. Selected supported maps/travel and data views keep their existing owners; no universal rung hierarchy, new panel, sampler, save schema, external research or runtime wave is selected (AD32).

folds.heading: ## U7 map/data-view content folded, 2026-11-04 (B86)
folds.body: The completed [U7 palette/report](gm/dispatch/ui-at-scale-2026-10-14/MAPS_AND_CHARTS.md) follows the earlier running-lane note. Retain U7:MP1–MP8/DV1–DV9 as proposed refinements to NV4/MO6/MW1/IN2: semantic rungs preserve selected identity and need not be continuous geometry; route, clue and prerequisite edges differ; grouping/legends/totals use the same observer-qualified evidence. Quantity formatting preserves stock, gross/usable output, inflow/outflow, transfer and net change, with actual units, clock, sample window and gaps. A purchase is not production; zero stock growth can coexist with useful output or waste. A quoted steady rate is not measured elapsed productivity or closed-app progress. Remote histories retain receipt age and compatible clocks instead of adding unrelated currencies/XP. A chart earns space for a real temporal/choice question; a compact value/rate can suffice. New history sampling, rungs, layout and atlas remain proposals under AD32, with current desktop targets and AD36/AD42/AD43 proof; no analytics or map prerequisite is added.

folds.heading: ## U7 map semantics retained, 2026-11-04 (B86)
folds.body: The [older map/chart palette](../gm/dispatch/ui-at-scale-2026-10-14/MAPS_AND_CHARTS.md) contributes compatible U7:MP1–MP8 distinctions without replacing this owner’s later departures-board source contract. Preserve selected target and return across map/list/rung changes, distinguish schematic connections from measured geometry, and label clue/report/prerequisite links separately from executable travel legs. Known geography, current occupants, sensed space, physical reach, legal access and control authority are separate facts; purchased maps or remote zoom do not supply all of them. A travel quote uses the actual actor/body/load/means and rechecks operation eligibility. Aggregates, unknown-node counts, labels, filters and legends cannot disclose more than their admitted source evidence. These remain proposed representation applications under AD32; no new route, world geometry, map acquisition, browser proof or replacement of the B58 compatibility-fallback decision occurred.
